lines: Bakul Hiralal Shah could receive up to ₹1.70 crore if all offered shares are sold; proceeds are in hand since 11 Mar 2026.
Trigger is recent: shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, though shares rather than cash.
Retained holding is an estimate of ₹3.97 crore at offer price, shown as (42,000 − 12,600) × ₹1,352.
Family link: shares surname and middle name with Atul Hiralal Shah. Gain is unknown, as average cost of acquisition is unverified.
